const globalConstant: string | undefined = "global";
const readConstant = () => globalConstant.length;
function closureLocal() { let local: string | undefined = "local"; const read = () => local.length; return read(); }
{ let blockLocal: string | undefined = "block"; const read = () => blockLocal.length; console.log(read()); }
console.log(readConstant(), closureLocal());
